list.title: How to use (Advanced Hair Growth Serum)
list.content:
Step 1
Spray on the affected scalp area.
Step 2
Message gently with your fingers to ensure it is absorbed properly and leave it on.

list.title: Important Information
list.content: Bodywise’s Hair Growth Pack is developed by trichologists with safe & effective ingredients. In order to get long lasting results, you need to use this for at least 3 months.

list.title: Who should use this Advanced Hair Serum?
list.content: Advanced Hair Growth serum can be used by anyone who is experiencing Stage 2 Hair Loss (more than 100 strands of hair fall per day &  hair thinning on scalp). Use for 3 months at least to see results.

list.title: How does the Advanced Hair Serum work?
list.content: Advanced Hair Growth Serum contains  2% Animexil. 2% Anagain, 3% Redensyl & 1% Rosemary. It helps stimulate hair growth by nourishing the hair follicles and improving scalp health.

list.title: What is Animexil?
list.content: Aminexil enhances blood vessel thickness, promoting improved blood circulation to the hair follicles. It strengthens the protective structure around our follicles, effectively preventing hair loss.

list.title: How do Redensyl & Anagain help in Hair Growth?
list.content: Redensyl and Anagain are derived from plants, promote healthy hair growth by prolonging the anagen phase. They shorten the telogen phase, resulting in a significant decrease in hair loss.  These natural actives for hair growth are often considered the best alternative to hair transplants due to their all-natural and non-hormonal hair regrowth qualities.

list.title: How long should I use this?
list.content: Use it everyday for 3 months for hair growth!

list.title: Is it safe for pregnant women?
list.content: Yes, its 100% Safe to use by pregnant women
